scope: Native F1 controls help, F2 flight-HUD visibility and F3 telemetry/fleet-panel visibility; shared manual-input release on ownership transitions. No new physics, graphics mode, wire payload or dependency.

contract.help: Visible help replaces other HUD/map widgets and suppresses native manual/camera input. F1 restores visible help from hidden UI. Opening/closing via hotkey or close button releases held manual/cursor/SAS-override demands, without pausing, cutting thrust or changing retained throttle/base SAS.
contract.visibility: Ordinary F2/F3 changes preserve held pilot keys. F2 suppresses flight HUD meshes and releases the navball callback resource; active map stays usable. F3 hides panels, not telemetry collection or transport. Visibility is session-only and resets on window-HUD recreation.
contract.resources: Help and hidden flight instruments release FastNavball. Same egui renderer/device/target retained; scene rendering and authority advancement continue.
contract.feature_off: No-default-features remains supported; HUD keys are absent without an enabled HUD.
